findings.detail: This leaf only filters one GNPS library-match table by quality thresholds and does not fuse the feature table, network, library, and SIRIUS evidence into a master table.

This leaf combines the feature table with GNPS, SIRIUS, and ISDB annotations into one per-feature indicator table, but it omits the molecular-network components required by the requested master table.
This leaf detects and aligns LC-MS/MS peaks but outputs an MS2 bag-of-fragments matrix rather than an aligned quantification table plus GNPS and SIRIUS MGF exports.
